requirements.text: The system shall receive real-time astronomical data from the Correlator in the form of Lag Frames.
The system shall assemble Lag Frames into continuous time-series (Lag Sets) for processing.
The system shall perform Fourier Transforms on the assembled Lag Sets.
The system shall provide a mechanism for user-selectable time-domain and frequency-domain processing.
The system shall format processed spectra and associated metadata for delivery to the End-to-End (e2e) system.
The system shall provide status, error, and warning reports to the Monitor and Control (M&C) system.
The system shall support remote monitoring and control of individual hardware and software components.
The system shall ensure all processing is reversible, allowing the original raw data to be recovered from the output.
The system shall support an aggregate input data stream from the Correlator of at least 1.6 Gbytes/sec.
The system shall support an output data stream to the e2e system of at least 25 MBytes/sec.
The system shall be scalable to handle up to 2 Gbytes per second per Correlator output channel in real-time.
The system shall be self-monitoring and capable of automatic recovery from processor, network, or software process failures.
The system shall maintain data integrity and continue operations during temporary loss of connectivity to the e2e system.
The system shall require unique user identification and authentication for all access.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict system configuration and management to authorized administrators.
The system shall log all access attempts and maintain an audit trail.
The system shall provide comprehensive documentation for all hardware configurations and software source code.
The system shall be designed using modular components to facilitate hot-swapping and non-disruptive maintenance.
